# dsh-task-checkpoint-guard
**Durable task checkpoints and safe, bounded recovery for DeepSeek Harness agents.**
English | 简体中文 | GitHub repository
> **Status: v0.2.1 (2026-11-04).** Developed and tested against **DSH 0.2.1-rc.3** on Windows 11 wit
h Node.js 24.21.0. v0.2.1 awaits local memory capture before prompt assembly so the first prompt see
s the just-received user message. The package declares the accepted DSH range in `engines.dsh`; othe
r versions are not claimed as tested. The optional memory subsystem is **off by default** and does n
ot change v0.1.0 checkpoint/recovery behavior. Released under the MIT License.
DSH agents can lose the thread when a long-running task is interrupted by a network failure, a provi
der timeout, a 5xx service error, or a process restart. The conversation log preserves history, but
a restarted agent still needs a compact, structured account of what it was doing: the objective, cur
rent step, completed tools, uncertain tool outcomes, todos, and the last visible results.
`dsh-task-checkpoint-guard` records that account locally, classifies recoverable transport failures,
optionally waits for a bounded readiness probe, and re-arms an existing DSH goal only when it is sa
fe to continue. It never saves hidden chain-of-thought and never uploads task records.
v0.2.0 adds an **optional hierarchical memory curator**: it can separate L0 goals and constraints fr
om L1 core questions/concepts, L2 prerequisites, and L3 details; maintain a concept dependency graph
; and inject a bounded, prerequisite-aware context before explanations. The feature defaults to `mem
oryEnabled: false`. When disabled, no memory tools or prompt sections are registered and the v0.1.0
checkpoint schema and recovery behavior remain unchanged.
## What it does
- Persists a structured checkpoint for every live DSH session as **JSON + Markdown + a session point

er**.
- Captures the original human instruction, goal objective/revision, todos, turn/step position,

tool lifecycle, and bounded visible results.
- Excludes model reasoning text; it stores only reason

ing block/character counts.
- Redacts credential-shaped strings and secret-looking JSON fields befor

e writing.
- Writes checkpoint files with a same-directory temporary file, `fsync`, and rename; reta

ins `<file>.previous` as the previous valid copy.
- Classifies `NETWORK`, `TIMEOUT`, `SERVICE`, `AUT

H_OR_REQUEST`, `ABORTED`, and `UNKNOWN` failures.
- Applies a fail-closed recovery policy:
- no auto

matic recovery after user cancellation, auth/request errors, max-token stops, or partial streams;
-

no automatic recovery while a tool call has no durable result;
- no blind retry of a tool call that

already completed or ended with an unknown outcome.
- Supports three recovery modes:
- `off` — check

rred` — explicit opt-in delay without an outbound probe.
- Re-arms an active, disarmed DSH goal with

a compare-and-set revision check, then injects one structured context message.
- Optionally denies
exact duplicate tool calls **during the first resumed turn**, after which the guard clears automatic

ally.
- Reconciles missing session events through the public `ctx.sessionQuery` service when it is a
econciles missing session events through the public `ctx.sessionQuery` service when it is available.
## Requirements

- **Node.js:** `^22.19.0` or `>=24.0.0` (the DSH runtime range declared by DSH 0.2.1-rc.3).
- **DSH:

** see `engines.dsh` in package.json. Locally tested with `0.2.1-rc.3`.
- Required host services: `a

gents`, `sessions`.
- Optional host capabilities:
- `goals` + `goal-round-driver` for automatic goal

happened before the plugin mounted or between a stale checkpoint and the live log;
- `tools` and `sy
stemPrompt` for the opt-in v0.2.0 memory tools and curated prompt section. If either registry is abs
ent, checkpointing/recovery still loads and memory tools/context degrade to unavailable; `memoryEnab

led` remains off by default.
- No npm runtime dependencies.
## Privacy and security
- Checkpoints are local-only and contain task text, bounded tool arguments/results, and session iden

tifiers. Treat the checkpoint directory as sensitive user data.
- Optional memory documents are also
local-only and may contain user goals, questions, concepts, correction history, and source referenc

es. They live under `memoryRoot` with the same sensitivity as session history.
- Credentials are res
olved per probe from DSH's credentials service. They are sent only as an `Authorization` header to t

he configured probe endpoint and are never written to state or logs.
- Probe redirects are rejected;

bearer probes require HTTPS unless the host is loopback.
- Common secret shapes and secret-looking
JSON keys are redacted before persistence. Redaction is defense in depth, not a guarantee that arbit

rary user text contains no secret. Do not put secrets in task prompts or tool arguments.
- File mode
`0600` is requested for checkpoint files. On Windows, effective access is controlled by the directo

ry ACL; protect `$DSH_HOME`.
- Multi-process writers to the same checkpoint root are not supported.
- Read SECURITY.md for the threat model and reporting guidance.
## Compatibility
| Surface | Status |
| DSH `0.2.1-rc.3` | Tested locally: Cordis loader smoke, public API integration tests, real `ToolRu

ntime` schema registration/execution, clean-profile install/uninstall smoke |
| Other DSH versions i

n `engines.dsh` | Accepted by the range but **not tested** |
| Memory curation | Deterministic tests
A–L pass; real-model pilot completed (4 cases, baseline 1/4 vs guarded 4/4 under rubric v2); single

-run pilot, not statistically validated |
| Node.js 24.21.0 on Windows 11 | Tested locally |
| Node.
js 22.19 / other operating systems | CI matrix is configured; not yet claimed as locally verified |
| DSH private APIs / private plugin source | Not used. See docs/architecture.md |
Automatic continuation additionally depends on the host mounting `@deepseek-ai/dsh-goal` and `@deeps
eek-ai/dsh-goal-round-driver`. If the driver is absent, checkpoints and context injection still work
, but a new model round may not be scheduled.
